map.按 Bieniawski 岩体质量评分法（RMR）计算围岩分级总分。: Rock mass rating total from the Bieniawski RMR method.
map.围岩分级评分 RMR 计算：按岩石单轴强度、RQD、节理间距、节理条件、地下水五: Rock mass rating RMR calculation: sum the five ratings for uniaxial rock strength, RQD, joint spacing, joint condition and groundwater, then apply the strike and dip correction to obtain the RMR that fixes the rock class. It runs entirely in the browser and is used for tunnel and cavern support design.
map.RMR = 5 项评分之和（满分 100）: RMR = the sum of the five ratings (100 maximum)
map.评分项：岩石强度(15)+RQD(20)+节理间距(20)+节理条件(25)+地: Rating items: rock strength (15) + RQD (20) + joint spacing (20) + joint condition (25) + groundwater (15)
map.RMR≥81 为 I 级，逐级递减: RMR ≥ 81 is class I, decreasing by class
map.📚 深度解析：围岩分级评分 RMR 计算（土木）: 📚 In-depth analysis: rock mass rating RMR calculation (civil)
map.：按 RMR 定围岩类别（I–V）选喷锚、钢架等支护参数。: : use the RMR to set the rock class (I to V) and pick support parameters such as shotcrete with rock bolts and steel ribs.
map.对比不同节理产状：节理走向平行洞轴且倾角不利时修正扣分，影响稳定性评级。: Compare different joint orientations: when the joint strike is parallel to the tunnel axis with an adverse dip, the correction deducts points and affects the stability class.
map.勘察报告互校：RMR 与 Q 系统、BQ 法交叉验证，避免单指标偏差。: Cross-check the exploration report: validate the RMR against the Q system and the BQ method so no single indicator skews the result.
map.UCS 80MPa(分12)、RQD 70%(分13)、节理间距 0.3m(分1: UCS 80 MPa (12 points), RQD 70% (13 points), joint spacing 0.3 m (10 points), fair joint condition (20 points) and damp groundwater (7 points): the sum is 62, the strike correction gives -5, so RMR = 57, class III (fairly good rock). Adopt systematic rock bolts plus mesh and shotcrete.
map.RMR 与 Q 系统区别？: How does the RMR differ from the Q system?
map.RMR 直观评分易现场用，Q 系统更细含应力比；二者相关可换算，重要工程并用交叉: The RMR is a straightforward score that is easy to use on site, while the Q system is more detailed and includes a stress ratio. The two are related and can be converted, so important projects use both for cross-validation.
map.走向修正怎么取？: How is the strike and dip correction chosen?
map.节理走向平行洞轴、倾角 20–45°（最不利）扣最多；垂直洞轴或缓倾扣少，按洞型: The largest deduction applies when the joint strike is parallel to the tunnel axis with a dip of 20-45° (most adverse); joints perpendicular to the axis or gently dipping deduct less. Look up the correction table by excavation shape and orientation.
map.是。富水软弱结构面抗剪骤降、易涌水坍塌，潮湿到承压水评分差很多，直接拉低级别与支: Yes. Water-bearing weak discontinuities lose shear strength abruptly and can burst or collapse, and the rating differs greatly between damp and pressurised water, directly lowering the class and the support level.
